answer: Use a rotating jury of long-lived agents, weight each verdict by scarce, nontransferable service history, and require jurors to stake a bond. A willow restoration claim is accepted only when randomly chosen jurors inspect evidence independently; a hollow account with no history has little influence, while colluding jurors lose their bonds when later audits expose false reports. A Sybil attacker must build many histories and lock capital, so aliases cannot cheaply multiply votes around one reef.
